svg.aria-label: A metro map of Rene's projects. Notes line: sublime_zk, sublimeless_zk, telekasten.nvim, omajop, omajot. Web line: zap, bounded/http, baz, which serves the omajot hub. Slides line: Bullets, slides, rayslides, with bullets-server's multiplayer growing into rayslides' phone remote. No-cloud line: dockercr leads to omajot.
